This list was reconstructed from the GEMP replay of Jonny Chu's quarterfinals game against [[Timo Dusel]] and is incomplete. It shows only cards that Jonny Chu revealed, played or drew in that game, and each count is the most copies seen at one time.<ref name="replay">[https://gemp.starwarsccg.org/gemp-swccg/game.html?replayId=dillen$4wbh94bddpp43sdb GEMP replay: Quarterfinals, Timo Dusel vs. Jonny Chu], gemp.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy (replay data): [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014090046/https://gemp.starwarsccg.org/gemp-swccg-server/replay/dillen$4wbh94bddpp43sdb Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hbi3fs0mvrI&t=3509s SWCCG CNVM: 2025 Invitational Deck Techs and Game Analysis from the Event Winner], BillBisco2, YouTube (1 February 2026), from 0:58:29. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012142507/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hbi3fs0mvrI Internet Archive]</ref>
